text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
＜Blocker＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with 1 or fewer digivolution cards can't attack or block until their turn ends.
(Rule) Trait: Has [Aquatic] Type.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If your hand has 7 or fewer cards, ＜Draw 1＞.

qa.answer: No, it will not. This effect targets one of your opponent's Digimon with one or fewer digivolution cards and gives it a "can't attack or block until their turn ends" effect. After the effect is given, it remains on the Digimon even if its digivolution cards increase.
qa.question: If a Digimon affected by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect later gains two or more digivolution cards, will it be able to attack and block?

qa.answer: It means you can't AA or BB.
qa.question: What exactly does a "can't AA/BB" effect mean?
